ctx.x: After a month at the "Reve", I worked a couple of weeks with a fellow known as Cuban Pete at the Ambassador where I had worked with Willie Lewis after I came back from India in 1937. Pete was an Algerian but most people didn't play an instrument but he was as smooth operator and had collaborated with his pianist and had published some music under his own name. The music that Cuban Pete's orchestra played was Cuban style with not a touch of jazz and I had to wear the Cuban type of shirt that all Cuban and many…

I was supposed to have played a concert in a town called Limoges with Edouard's band and Don Byas before the band broke up, but missed the gig because I thought that I knew how to get the railroad station we were to leave from with the metro.(subway) I did get to the station which was gare d' Austerlitz, but too late for the train the others had taken because I went the wrong direction inthe subway. No one I came in contact with at the station could speak english. I tried to find out if there was another train…

I stayed with Jean-Marie whose wife's name was Paulette, They had a daughter named Sylvie who was 5 years old and one about 2 years old called Agnes. Jean believed in eating good and his wife was a very good cook. I had some french food that I had never heard about and that sent me. Little Sylvie, I adopted as my little mamma, because she was with me all the time I was awake and would get me a glass of cognac or whatever I wanted to drink wheever I asked her. I let her blow my horn and she really got a sound out…
